observations: Roles 555–557 construct a balance, reckoning table, candle stand, spinning stool and printing apparatus from a specification envelope and fixed offsets. Several dimensions are differences of envelope dimensions and fixed values, and some construction normalizes displacement vectors. The actual key/spec ranges and resulting native admission must be checked before treating a nonpositive or degenerate input as reachable.

Roles 558–559 construct a horizontal loom with derived width/depth, threads, rollers, wheels and suspension, using distinct solid and decorative members. Input envelope bounds, fixed-count arithmetic and moving-part ownership remain untraced; these static source bodies do not establish an animated product behavior.

Role 560 validates cuboid member inputs through frame-aware corners, retains the first construction error and checks aggregate bounds before returning a furniture recipe. It distinguishes visible decoration from solid colliders, recentres meshes/colliders/supports/clearances, and assigns local source IDs. Unchecked mesh-only quad/triangle producers and cross-instance identity require their own connected assessment.

Role 561 supplies barrel and cargo variants, separate visible slats/sacks and coarse collision proxies, and access/working clearances. Intentional proxy approximation should be judged against actual placement and physics consumers, not equated with exact render geometry.
No furniture recipe, product build, test, simulation, rendering or runtime probe ran.
